The structure of Cs8Sb4I12 (reduced formula Cs2SbI3) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Sb centers in octahedral environments of six I neighbors, while Cs centers exhibit a close-packed-like local arrangement of twelve I neighbors. The Cs-centered 12-vertex polyhedra share corners with Sb octahedra and faces with one another, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
